18444.new_name: The Original Rose Toy in Seven Colors
18444.desc:
This is the one the category is named after — the original rose toy, the flower-shaped suction vibrator that went viral on social media and turned a whole product class rose-red. No suffixes, no version numbers: the silicone flower, the suction head at its center, and seven colorways to choose among.

Seven suction patterns drive the center, each a different rhythm of the rotating airflow the toy pioneered — the pulsing pull that surrounds the clitoris rather than pressing it, closer to oral attention than any vibration pattern manages. One click steps the patterns; a long press starts and stops.

The materials are the medical grade the original became known for: hypoallergenic, non-reactive silicone safe for sensitive skin, with a silk-touch finish over the whole bud. The body carries an IPX6 waterproof rating, so shower use and full rinse-cleaning are both routine rather than exceptions.

Charging is the magnetic-base system — set the flower on its USB dock, and a full charge returns up to two hours of play. Seven colors, seven patterns, one original: the reference point every later rose toy is measured against.

  • Suction patterns: 7
  • Colors: seven available
  • Material: medical-grade hypoallergenic silicone
  • Charging: magnetic USB base, up to 2 h play
  • Waterproof: IPX6
